description: Fork of exp693 (1.4379 @ 97.5M, <100M SOTA). Single addition: a pre_lut between tok_emb_E and the LUTBlock stack, with v_lut's settings (NAP=6, tph=256, n_heads=6, n_out=d_v=24). pre_lut output [B*T, 6, 24] reshaped to [B, T, E=144] (6*24 = E) and added residually to x_lut. Motivated by attention analysis: trained exp693 has L0 self_mass=0.45 (vs vanilla 0.013, 35x higher); the model appears to use L0's attention as a per-token non-linear transform path (because there is no FFN in LUTBlocks). pre_lut gives that role a dedicated module right after the embedding, freeing L0 attention for cross-token routing. Param impact: +2.36M -> 99.88M total (still <100M). Refs: exp693=1.4379 @ 97.5M, exp684=1.4262 @ 140M, exp476=1.4143 @ 35.8M (vanilla).
